operator_io_quirks: All identifiers UPPER_CASE, no spaces; double-quoting still required by spec.
IMG_OBJ 1.75M rows, IMG_OBJ_ATT 1.07M, IMG_REL 763k: read_schema must rowid-sample (max_rows_per_table) not full-scan.

IMG_REL has TWO FKs to IMG_OBJ (OBJ1_SAMPLE_ID, OBJ2_SAMPLE_ID) plus a composite FK (IMG_ID,OBJ1/OBJ2_SAMPLE_ID)->IMG_OBJ(IMG_ID,OBJ_SAMPLE_ID); pragma foreign_key_list returns 5 rows, two of which are the same (IMG_ID) pair — dedupe by (child_col,parent,parent_col).

Composite FK to a composite PK: schema.fks is keyed (child_t,child_c)->(parent_t,parent_c) single-column; the (IMG_ID,OBJ_SAMPLE_ID) composite edge must be represented as two single-column edges (IMG_ID->IMG_OBJ.IMG_ID, OBJ_SAMPLE_ID->OBJ_OBJ_SAMPLE_ID) — matches pragma output, but note the parent column is NOT unique alone (IMG_ID distinct 11907 of 1.75M).

FK parent columns IMG_OBJ.IMG_ID and IMG_OBJ.OBJ_SAMPLE_ID are non-unique parents: fill_foreign_keys_consistently draws with replacement from parent's final column, fine, but child rows will not be unique on (IMG_ID,OBJ_SAMPLE_ID) — PK dedupe in IMG_OBJ_ATT/IMG_REL will drop many rows.
All columns declared INTEGER, storage class integer everywhere; no text-stored dates, no mixed storage, no NULLs observed (null_rate 0.0) despite nullable DDL on IMG_OBJ.X/Y/W/H/OBJ_CLASS_ID.
Declared types dispatch cleanly: INTEGER->Number, TEXT->String; no crash-fallback, no Date/Time/Bool/Bit columns.
PKs are composite on IMG_OBJ(2), IMG_OBJ_ATT(3), IMG_REL(4); single-column PKs on the three class tables. Composite-PK members get max_l0=30 per spec.
IMG_OBJ.OBJ_CLASS_ID is nullable FK but original has 0 nulls and 300 distinct = full parent cardinality; TS may emit NULLs there (allowed by DDL).

IMG_REL.IMG_ID samples include 2316535/2318367 > IMG_OBJ max IMG_ID (11907 distinct but max value large) — parent IMG_ID values are sparse/large; Number fuzzer range [-10^0,10^0] with scale=0 will produce tiny ints, not matching.
No views, triggers, or indexes in DDL; empty-clone for neighbor executability is trivial.
No self-references, no dangling FKs, no missing parents.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on all INTEGER columns with scale=0: range [-1,1] (unsigned false), so fresh draws are -1/0/1 perturbed by +-1/+-2 — implausibly tiny vs real IMG_ID up to millions, X/Y/W/H up to ~800.

String fuzzer on ATT_CLASS/OBJ_CLASS/PRED_CLASS: 5 original samples + pool literals, then 50% contaminate (suffix/prefix/drop char) — produces near-miss strings, drives FN on equality/IN predicates and FP on LIKE.
Number list-range quirk (list_max overwritten to full-range max) means element-based draws still bounded by [-1,1] for scale=0 — ties/duplicates collapse, likely FP on DISTINCT/COUNT queries.

Composite PK dedupe (sample_fresh_primary_keys) on IMG_OBJ_ATT/IMG_REL with tiny integer domains will drop most rows: e.g. IMG_OBJ_ATT PK (IMG_ID,ATT_CLASS_ID,OBJ_SAMPLE_ID) with IMG_ID in {-1,0,1} and ATT_CLASS_ID in {-1,0,1} gives <=9 distinct PKs before FK draw — severe row loss, likely FN on COUNT/aggregate queries.

FK fill draws from parent's FINAL filtered column with replacement: IMG_OBJ_ATT.IMG_ID and OBJ_SAMPLE_ID drawn independently from IMG_OBJ's surviving (IMG_ID,OBJ_SAMPLE_ID) columns, so pairs need not exist in IMG_OBJ — join queries return 0 rows, FN.

IMG_REL has 5 FK edges (2 to IMG_OBJ.IMG_ID, 2 to IMG_OBJ.OBJ_SAMPLE_ID, 1 to PRED_CLASSES); each child column drawn independently, so (IMG_ID,OBJ1_SAMPLE_ID) and (IMG_ID,OBJ2_SAMPLE_ID) pairs rarely match IMG_OBJ — join-heavy queries FN.
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement in Python; rows violating PK/unique dropped at insert (writedb) — but here PKs are the only constraints, so insert failures rare.
p=0.2 default, whole-instance p=0 w.p. 0.3: 30% of instances use only original+pool elements (no fresh), giving realistic values but few ties.
max_l0 cap (rng*30) on fresh draws: after ~30 fresh values per column, reuse — small domains, many duplicates, FP on DISTINCT.
No Date/Time/Bool columns, so date/time fuzzers unused; no special_cases apply.
